questions.q: Which employment sector would a research scientist belong to?
questions.why: Research and development is knowledge-based work, the quaternary sector.

questions.q: In the Clark-Fisher model, which sector is largest in a low-income country?
questions.why: Low-income countries rely on subsistence farming and extraction, so primary employment dominates.

questions.q: Which is the best definition of informal employment?
options: work that is not registered or taxed by the government
work in factories owned by TNCs
questions.why: Informal jobs have no contract, tax or regulation, e.g. street vending.

questions.q: Explain one negative impact of an economic sector shift in a named developed country.
questions.model: In the UK the decline of coal mining led to job losses in South Wales mining towns, causing a negative multiplier as shops closed and young people moved away.
points: named country and sector shift (e.g. decline of mining/manufacturing)
a negative impact such as unemployment
development such as negative multiplier or out-migration
